title: Japan Race Weekend Tour
alt: Floodlit grandstand and track in Japan at dusk
transport: Coaches, trains and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel at Kadoma, on the line into central Osaka

activities.name: Osaka sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city: Osaka castle and its park, the Dotonbori canal and the market lanes around Kuromon.

activities.name: Kyoto and Arashiyama day trip
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, then the bamboo grove at Arashiyama and the lanes along the Katsura river.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights at Kadoma with a free day for the race or optional tours, a city day and a day out to Kyoto with Arashiyama.

stops.name: Nagoya
stops.subtitle: Nagoya to Nara and Nabana no Sato
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Modern hotel in the Sakae district of Nagoya

activities.name: Todai-ji temple and Nara deer park
activities.match: Trip to Todai-ji Temple & Nara Deer Park
activities.description: The great bronze Buddha inside Todai-ji, then the deer park where the tame sika deer bow for biscuits.

activities.name: Nabana no Sato illumination
activities.description: The flower park near Nagoya, where millions of lights are strung into tunnels and fields once the sun goes down.

program.name: Nagoya
program.description: A night in Nagoya, reached through Nara's temple and deer park, with the Nabana no Sato lights after dark.

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Hakone
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel at Musashi-Kosugi, fifteen minutes from Shibuya

activities.name: Hakone ropeway
activities.description: The cable car over the sulphur vents of Owakudani, with Mount Fuji across the valley when the sky is clear.

activities.name: Lake Ashi cruise
activities.description: A cruise across Lake Ashi past the red torii gate standing in the water at Hakone shrine.

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights at Musashi-Kosugi, reached over the Hakone ropeway and Lake Ashi, with a city day and a free day.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Built around a race weekend in Kansai, with two free days to use for the circuit and the rest of Japan around it.
expert.tip: Tell us your race dates and we will line the free days up with practice and the main event, then keep the touring for the days between.

summary: Nine days built around a race weekend: four nights near Osaka with a free day for the circuit, a city tour and Kyoto with Arashiyama, a night in Nagoya via Nara and the Nabana no Sato lights, then three nights in Tokyo reached over the Hakone ropeway.
included: Included: 8 nights with daily breakfast and dinner on four evenings; coaches and trains throughout; Osaka sightseeing tour; Kyoto tour with the Arashiyama bamboo grove; Todai-ji temple and Nara deer park; Nabana no Sato tickets; Hakone ropeway and Lake Ashi cruise; Tokyo sightseeing tour; two free days for the race or optional tours.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; race tickets and circuit transfers; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
